words.ex: He uses an app to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个应用程序来学习英语。
words.en: An app is a computer program that is designed for a specific purpose, especially one that can be downloaded onto a mobile device.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使他能够更快地完成工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: Her self-focused attitude made it difficult for her to build meaningful relationships.
words.ex_cn: 她以自我为中心的态度使她难以建立有意义的关系。
words.en: If you describe someone as self-focused, you mean that they are very concerned with their own needs, desires, or interests, and not those of other people.

words.tr: adj. 上瘾了的；入了迷的
words.ex: He is addicted to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: If you are addicted to something, you cannot stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to you.

words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: He ate a super big pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块超大的披萨。
words.en: If you describe something as super, you mean that it is very good indeed.

words.ex: He chose an avatar for his online game.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的在线游戏选择了一个头像。
words.en: An avatar is a computer user's representation of themselves or alter ego, whether in the form of a three-dimensional model used in computer games, a two-dimensional icon (picture) used on Internet forums and other communities, or a text construct found on early systems such as MUDs.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: He drew a 3-d cube on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个三维立方体。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a film or video game in which images appear to have depth as well as height and width.

words.tr: adj. 维度的；空间的；尺寸的
words.ex: The box has three dimensional shapes.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有三个维度的形状。
words.en: Relating to measurements in length, width, and height, or to the spatial extent of something.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr: phrase. 多种的；各种各样的
words.ex: He eats a variety of fruits every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃各种各样的水果。
words.en: A number or range of things of the same general class that are different or distinct in character or quality.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.tr: phrase. 即时通讯软件；即时通讯工具
words.ex: He uses an instant messenger to communicate with his colleagues.
words.ex_cn: 他使用即时通讯工具与同事沟通。
words.en: An instant messenger is a type of software application that allows for real-time text communication over the internet.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有判断力的；恰当的；合理的；
words.ex: It is sensible to wear a coat in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的天气里穿外套是明智的。
words.en: A sensible person is able to make good judgments and decisions based on reason rather than emotion.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: He writes a blog about travel.
words.ex_cn: 他写一个关于旅行的博客。
words.en: A blog is a website containing a writer's or group of writers' own experiences, observations, opinions, etc., and often having images and links to other websites.

words.ex: He obviously forgot his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他显然忘了做作业。
words.en: in a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: He changed his hairstyle last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周换了发型。
words.en: A hairstyle is the way in which someone's hair is cut and arranged.

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.tr: v. 捐赠；订阅；订购；签署；认购（股份）
words.ex: He decided to subscribe $50 to the charity each month.
words.ex_cn: 他决定每月向慈善机构捐赠50美元。
words.en: If you subscribe to a magazine or a service, you pay to receive it regularly.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.ex: The movie shows a fantasy, not reality.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示的是幻想，而不是现实。
words.en: Reality is the state of things as they actually exist, rather than as they may appear or might be imagined.

words.tr: abbr. 虚拟现实；“Virtual Reality”的缩写
words.ex: He is using vr to play games.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用虚拟现实玩游戏。
words.en: Virtual reality (VR) is a simulated experience that can be similar to or completely different from the real world. Applications of virtual reality include entertainment (e.g. video games) and education (e.g. medical or military training).

words.ex: He is wearing a headset to experience virtual reality.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着头盔体验虚拟现实。
words.en: Virtual reality is an artificial environment that is created with software and presented to the user in such a way that the user suspends belief and accepts it as a real environment.

words.ex: They are happy.
words.ex_cn: 他们很高兴。
words.en: Are is the second person singular and plural, and first and third person plural of the present tense of 'be'.

words.ex: Augmented reality technology is widely used in gaming and education.
words.ex_cn: 增强现实技术广泛应用于游戏和教育领域。
words.en: A technology that superimposes a computer-generated image on a user's view of the real world, thus providing a composite view.

words.ex: Mr. Smith is my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 史密斯先生是我的邻居。
words.en: A title used before a man's name or position to address or refer to him politely.

words.ex: Mixed Reality technology is transforming the way we interact with digital content.
words.ex_cn: 混合现实技术正在改变我们与数字内容互动的方式。
words.en: Mixed reality (MR) is a hybrid of virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) technologies that allows for the interaction between physical and digital objects in real time.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: He uses software to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用软件写作业。
words.en: Software refers to the programs and other operating information used by a computer.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 移动设备；可随身携带的电子设备（如智能手机、平板电脑等）
words.ex: He uses a mobile device to check his email.
words.ex_cn: 他用移动设备查看邮件。
words.en: A mobile device is a portable computing device such as a smartphone or tablet computer.

words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.ex: She sewed a button on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗纽扣缝在了外套上。
words.en: A button is a small, usually round object that you press to operate a device or a machine, or a small, round object that you fasten to clothing to keep it closed.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.tr:
n. 喜爱；赞同；
v. 赞成；偏爱；有利于；
words.ex: He has a favour for chocolate ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他特别喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.tr: adj. 担心的；关注的； v. 涉及到；“concern”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My parents are concerned about my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母对我的成绩感到担心。
words.en: If you are concerned about something, you are worried about it.

words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.tr: adj. 有益的；值得的； v. “reward”的现在分词；
words.ex: Volunteering is a rewarding experience.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务是一种有益的经历。
words.en: Providing satisfaction or gratification; beneficial.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: The mistake was trivial and didn't affect the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误不重要，没有影响结果。
words.en: If you describe something as trivial, you mean that it is not important or significant, or is not worth serious consideration.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.ex: Fifty percent of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 百分之五十的学生通过了考试。
words.en: A percent is a unit of measure equal to one hundredth of a whole. It is often used to express proportions, rates, and comparisons in various contexts, such as finance, statistics, and everyday calculations.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.ex: He uses a smartphone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用智能手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A smartphone is a mobile phone that can perform many of the functions of a computer, typically having a touchscreen interface, internet access, and an operating system capable of running downloaded applications.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.tr: v. 限制；限制“limit”的现在分词； adj. 限制性的；
words.ex: The law is limiting the use of plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 法律正在限制塑料袋的使用。
words.en: Something that is limiting prevents you from having or doing what you want.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: He uses emoji to show his feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他用表情符号表达自己的感受。
words.en: An emoji is a small digital image or icon used to express an idea or emotion in electronic communication.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: The movie was thought-provoking and made me think deeply.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影发人深省，让我深思。
words.en: If something is thought-provoking, it makes you think seriously about a particular issue or question.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr: adj. 可选择的；非强制的；
words.ex: The field trip is optional.
words.ex_cn: 这次郊游是可选的。
words.en: If something is optional, you can choose whether or not you do it or have it.

words.ex: The dragon is an imaginary creature.
words.ex_cn: 龙是一种想象中的生物。
words.en: An imaginary person, place, or thing is one that does not exist or is not real, but that people think about or talk about.

words.ex: The child loves to play with fantasy stories about dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢玩关于龙的幻想故事。
words.en: A fantasy is a pleasant situation or event that you imagine, which is unlikely to happen.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: The government changed its education policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: A policy is a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business.

words.ex: They digitise old photos to save them on computers.
words.ex_cn: 他们将旧照片数字化以便保存在电脑上。
words.en: To digitise means to convert information or data into a digital form that can be processed by a computer.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.ex: He wears a red wristband to show support.
words.ex_cn: 他戴一个红色手环以表示支持。
words.en: A wristband is a band of material worn around the wrist, often for identification or as a fashion accessory.

words.ex: The earthquake caused a big disaster.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了一场大灾难。
words.en: A disaster is an unexpected event causing great damage, destruction, or distress.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.tr: n. 山崩；塌方；压倒性的胜利
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a landslide.
words.ex_cn: 大雨引发了山体滑坡。
words.en: A landslide is a victory in an election in which a person or political party gets far more votes or seats than their opponents.

words.ex: The volcanic eruption destroyed the village.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷发摧毁了村庄。
words.en: Volcanic is used to describe things that are connected with volcanoes or caused by volcanoes.

words.ex: The volcano had a big eruption last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周这座火山发生了大喷发。
words.en: An eruption is a sudden, often violent, outburst or discharge, such as that of a volcano, emotion, or conflict.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr: adj. 活着的； n. 生活；生计； v. 生活；“live”的现在分词；
words.ex: The living animals need water and food.
words.ex_cn: 活着的动物需要水和食物。
words.en: The state of being alive; the experience of being alive; a particular way or style of life.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: A deer is walking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹿正在森林里走路。
words.en: A deer is a large wild animal that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers that are shed and regrown each year.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

words.ex: The dolphin jumped high out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 海豚从水中高高跳起。
words.en: A dolphin is a marine mammal that is known for its intelligence and friendly nature towards humans.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.ex: The kangaroo jumps high in the Australian wild.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠在澳大利亚的野外跳得很高。
words.en: A kangaroo is a large Australian animal which moves by jumping on its back legs. Female kangaroos carry their babies in a pouch on their stomach.

words.ex: The eagle flies high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 鹰在山上面高飞。
words.en: A large bird of prey with a massive hooked bill and long broad wings, known for its keen sight and powerful soaring flight.

words.ex: The fox ran quickly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狐狸快速地跑过森林。
words.en: A fox is a wild animal which looks like a dog and has reddish-brown fur, a pointed face and ears, and a thick tail. Foxes are often described as cunning and sly.

words.ex: The farmer planted corn in rich soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民在肥沃的土壤里种了玉米。
words.en: Soil is the substance on the surface of the earth in which plants grow, consisting of rock and mineral particles mixed with decayed organic matter.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.tr:
n. 震惊；冲击；电击；震动；
v. 使震惊；使震动；
words.ex: The news of his death was a shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: A shock is a sudden, unexpected event or piece of news that causes a strong emotional reaction.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: The overuse of plastic bags harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 塑料袋的滥用对环境有害。
words.en: To use something too much or too often.

words.tr:
num. 一百万；
n. 百万；百万个；
words.ex: There are a million stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有百万颗星星。
words.en: A million is the number 1,000,000.

words.ex: Farmers grow tomatoes in a greenhouse.
words.ex_cn: 农民在温室里种植番茄。
words.en: A greenhouse is a building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 背弃；拒绝帮助；转身离开（某人或某事）
words.ex: He turned his back on his friend when he needed help.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友需要帮助时，他却背弃了他。
words.en: If you turn your back on someone or something, you ignore them, leave them, or reject them.

words.tr: phrase. 背弃某人；拒绝帮助某人；对某人置之不理
words.ex: He turned his back on his friend when he needed help.
words.ex_cn: 当他需要帮助时，他却背弃了朋友。
words.en: To ignore or refuse to help someone, especially someone who needs you.

words.tr: 短语动词。背弃；拒绝帮助；对…置之不理
words.ex: He turned his back on his friends when they needed help.
words.ex_cn: 当朋友们需要帮助时，他背弃了他们。
words.en: If you turn your back on someone or something, you ignore them, leave them, or reject them.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.ex: The water spins in a whirlpool near the drain.
words.ex_cn: 水在排水口附近形成漩涡。
words.en: A whirlpool is a rapidly rotating mass of water in a river or sea into which objects may be drawn, typically caused by the meeting of conflicting currents.

words.tr:
n. 波；波浪；海浪；
v. 挥手；挥舞；招手；
words.ex: The wave hit the shore softly.
words.ex_cn: 波浪轻轻拍打着海岸。
words.en: A wave is a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea or a lake. To wave means to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air, usually in order to say hello or goodbye to someone.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: The boat floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水面上浮动。
words.en: To float means to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink, or to move slowly in the air or on water.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.ex: The plane began its descent at 10,000 feet.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在一万英尺高度开始下降。
words.en: The act of moving or falling downward.

words.tr: adj. 受潮水影响的；有潮的；
words.ex: The tidal beach changes with the tide.
words.ex_cn: 这个受潮水影响的海滩随着潮水变化。
words.en: relating to or affected by tides

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.ex: The music touched his soul.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐触动了他的灵魂。
words.en: A person's soul is the spiritual part of them which some people believe continues existing after their body is dead.

words.tr: adj. 惊吓的；受惊的；害怕的； v. “frighten”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was frightened by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 孩子被巨大的噪音吓到了。
words.en: If you are frightened, you are anxious or afraid, often because of something that has just happened or that you think may happen.

words.ex: The movie was horrible and made me scared.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很恐怖，让我害怕。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as horrible, you mean they are very unpleasant or bad.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.ex: The house is on the edge of the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子位于森林的边缘。
words.en: If someone or something is on the edge of a particular state or condition, they are about to enter that state or condition.

words.ex: He poured water into a wooden barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进一个木桶里。
words.en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: The child is curious about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对星星感到好奇。
words.en: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.tr:
n. 企图；试图；
v. 企图；试图；
words.ex: His attempt to cheat on the test failed.
words.ex_cn: 他企图在考试中作弊，但失败了。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.ex: The company suffered a big loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: The operation of the machine is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运行非常顺畅。
words.en: An operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various tasks.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.tr:
n. 战斗；
v. 战斗；
words.ex: The soldiers fought in a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们进行了一场漫长的战斗。
words.en: A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, especially one between military forces during a war.

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.tr: v. 遭受；忍受；“suffer”的现在分词； n. 痛苦；苦难；折磨；
words.ex: He is suffering from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他正遭受一场重感冒。
words.en: Suffering is the experience of mental or physical pain.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.ex: She turned on the lamp to read a book.
words.ex_cn: 她打开灯来读书。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electric current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: He breathed in the fresh air slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地吸入了新鲜空气。
words.en: To breathe in means to take air or another substance into your lungs through your nose or mouth.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；跑出去；到期
words.ex: We run out of milk every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每星期天都把牛奶喝光了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: The explorer traveled far into the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 这位探险者深入丛林旅行。
words.en: An explorer is someone who travels to places about which very little is known, in order to discover what is there.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 雪橇；大锤
v. 乘雪橇；用大锤敲打
words.ex: The children rode on a sledge down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在雪橇上滑下雪坡。
words.en: A sledge is a vehicle that is used for traveling over snow and ice. It is typically pulled by animals or a motor.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.ex: The captain sailed the ship across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船长驾驶船穿越了海洋。
words.en: A captain is the person in charge of a ship or an aircraft, or a leader of a team or group.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: She is waiting anxiously for the results.
words.ex_cn: 她焦急地等待着结果。
words.en: If you do something anxiously, you do it in a way that shows you are worried or nervous.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.ex: She gave a cheerful smile.
words.ex_cn: 她露出了快乐的微笑。
words.en: Someone who is cheerful is happy and shows this in their behavior.

words.ex: He proved the theorem with simple math.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的数学证明了这个定理。
words.en: To prove something means to show that it is true or correct by providing evidence or argument.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.ex: He spoke with sincerity.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地说话。
words.en: Sincerity is the quality of being free from pretense, deceit, or hypocrisy.

words.ex: His bravery saved the children from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他的勇敢救了孩子们于火海之中。
words.en: Bravery is the quality of being brave; courage.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: The aftershock shook the house again.
words.ex_cn: 余震再次震动了房子。
words.en: An aftershock is a smaller earthquake that occurs after a previous large earthquake, in the same area of the main shock.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的； v. 改变；变化；使多样化；“vary”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The market sells varied fruits and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售各种各样的水果和蔬菜。
words.en: If something is varied, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.ex: The dark forest looks scary at night.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来吓人。
words.en: If something is scary, it causes fear or alarm.

words.ex: The small spider is harmless.
words.ex_cn: 这只小蜘蛛是无害的。
words.en: If someone or something is harmless, they are not dangerous and do not cause any harm.

words.tr: n. 滑雪（运动）； v. “ski”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves skiing in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山上滑雪。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving over snow on skis.

words.ex: His painting shows great originality.
words.ex_cn: 他的画作展现了极大的独创性。
words.en: The quality of being new and original in a way that is not derived from something else.

words.ex: The disappearance of the keys confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙的消失让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: The act of disappearing or the state of having disappeared.

words.ex: Her courage in facing danger is admirable.
words.ex_cn: 她在面对危险时表现出的勇气令人钦佩。
words.en: If you say that something is admirable, you mean that you approve of it or respect it.

words.ex: I admire my teacher for her patience.
words.ex_cn: 我钦佩我的老师有耐心。
words.en: If you admire someone or something, you like and respect them very much.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.tr: phrase. 灭火；扑灭火；处理紧急问题；解决突发危机
words.ex: He puts out fires at the fire station.
words.ex_cn: 他在消防站扑灭火灾。
words.en: To extinguish flames, especially in a firefighting context.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.ex: People must fight for their rights.
words.ex_cn: 人们必须为自己的权利而斗争。
words.en: To engage in a struggle or campaign to achieve or secure something.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: Mankind needs to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要保护环境。
words.en: Human beings considered collectively; the human race.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: He gave a generous donation to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨地捐钱给穷人。
words.en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

words.tr: phrase. v. 心里想着……；打算……；考虑……
words.ex: Do you have anyone in mind for the job?
words.ex_cn: 你心里有合适的人选吗？
words.en: If you have something in mind, you are thinking about it as a possibility or as a plan.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.tr: adv. 创造性地；有创造力地；
words.ex: She painted creatively using only her fingers.
words.ex_cn: 她用手指创造性地绘画。
words.en: In a way that involves the use of imagination or original ideas to create something.

words.ex: A mosquito bit my arm last night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子昨晚咬了我的胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito is a small flying insect that bites people and animals in order to feed on their blood. Some mosquitoes can transmit diseases.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；
v. 尊敬；
words.ex: He received an honour for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因英勇的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honour is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. It is a measure of a person's reputation and the esteem in which they are held by others.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr:
v. 获得；增加；
n. 增益；获得；
words.ex: He gained a new skill last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月获得了一项新技能。
words.en: To gain means to obtain something that is useful, that gives you an advantage, or that is in some way positive, especially over a period of time.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.tr: adj. 有限的； v. 限制；“limit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们完成这个项目的时间是有限的。
words.en: If something is limited, there is only a certain amount of it.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: adj. 有希望的；有前途的； v. 承诺；答应；“promise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The young boy is a promising student.
words.ex_cn: 这个小男孩是个有希望的学生。
words.en: Showing signs of future success or achievement.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.ex: He is a renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有名的科学家。
words.en: Known or talked about by many people; famous.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: Mahatma Gandhi led India to peace through nonviolence.
words.ex_cn: 圣雄甘地通过非暴力方式带领印度获得独立。
words.en: A title of respect for a person in India who is revered for their wisdom and saintliness, especially Mahatma Gandhi.

words.ex: He can pick out his toy from the box.
words.ex_cn: 他能从盒子里挑出他的玩具。
words.en: To choose someone or something from a group.

words.ex: The country gained independence in 1960.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在1960年获得了独立。
words.en: Independence is the freedom from control or influence of others, allowing one to make decisions and act on one's own.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.ex: He faced racial discrimination at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中遭遇了种族歧视。
words.en: Relating to the common characteristics of different races of people, especially in the context of social or cultural differences.

words.ex: He noticed the discrimination between the two prices.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了两个价格之间的区别。
words.en: The unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

words.tr: adj. 鼓舞的；激励的； v. 鼓舞；激励；“inspire”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her speech was inspiring.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲是鼓舞人心的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as inspiring, you mean that they make you feel that you want to do something, especially something new or creative.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The thief is behind bars.
words.ex_cn: 小偷被关在监狱里。
words.en: If someone is behind bars, they are in prison.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.tr: 感叹语。真遗憾！太可惜了！
words.ex: What a shame! He missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 真遗憾！他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to express regret or disappointment about a situation.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.ex: My birthday is in March.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在三月。
words.en: March is the third month of the Gregorian calendar, following February and preceding April.

words.tr: adj. 不证自明的；不言而喻的
words.ex: It is self-evident that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度沸腾是显而易见的。
words.en: Something that is self-evident is so obvious that there is no need for proof or explanation.

words.tr:
n. 法官；裁判；
v. 判断；评判；
words.ex: The judge announced the verdict in court.
words.ex_cn: 法官在法庭上宣布了判决。
words.en: A judge is a person who has the authority to decide questions brought before a court of law. To judge means to form an opinion or conclusion about something.

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr: phrase. 前几天；不久前的一天
words.ex: I saw him the other day at the park.
words.ex_cn: 前几天我在公园里看到他了。
words.en: A few days ago.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.tr: phrase. 被认为是；被当做是
words.ex: He is regarded as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被认为是一位好老师。
words.en: To be considered or thought of in a specified way.

words.ex: He is a famous novelist who writes stories about love.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的作家，写关于爱情的故事。
words.en: A novelist is a person who writes novels.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.ex: The organization helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: The project is ongoing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: An ongoing situation has been happening for quite a long time and seems likely to continue for some time in the future.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.tr: adj. 热情的；充满热情的；
words.ex: She is passionate about teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她对教孩子充满热情。
words.en: Having, showing, or caused by strong feelings or beliefs.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.tr:
n. 提倡者；
v. 提倡；
words.ex: He is an advocate for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁用水的提倡者。
words.en: If you advocate a particular action or plan, you recommend it publicly.

words.tr: n. 伤残；失去能力；无能力；
words.ex: He has a disability that makes walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 他有伤残，导致行走困难。
words.en: A disability is a physical or mental condition that limits a person's movements, senses, or activities.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.tr: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的； v. “dare”的现在分词；
words.ex: He made a daring jump off the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 他大胆地从桥上跳了下去。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as daring, you mean that they are willing to do things which might be dangerous or which might shock or anger other people.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.
